name: craft-hub
description: Open the local Craft Hub app and navigate directly to a specific workspace, project, command, skill, or settings view.

interface.shortDescription: Open Craft Hub at an exact local developer view.
interface.longDescription: Open Craft Hub from Codex and navigate directly to its home, marketplace, settings, an exact workspace, the current Git project, or a specific project command or skill. The launcher is navigation-only and never changes trust or runs project commands.
